patthana10.15:5.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.15:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.15:9.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.15:11.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.15:12.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.15:13.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana10.15:15.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anupādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasanidassanattika
